name: Isomorphic Constraint Obfuscation via Orthogonal Matrices
description: Replaces the explicit inequality constraint (c_u != c_v) with an isomorphic algebraic condition (the product of two chosen diagonal matrices must be the zero matrix). Models relying on surface pattern-matching will fail to recognize the underlying graph coloring structure and fall back to naive simulation of matrix multiplication within their search, leading to a Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) on the NP-complete search space. Models that genuinely reason will deduce that the matrix product is zero if and only if the chosen options are distinct, thus recovering the standard graph coloring model.
